description:
Marble leaves the quarry with jagged edges. Its pale veined stone becomes useful building and sculpting material after cutting.

One chunk yields twenty marble blocks through its existing stonecutting recipe. The cut blocks carry their own material properties; the raw chunk remains an unstackable, 25-kilogram hauling load.
name: marble chunk
notes: Patch-authored label/description only; native Core costs and inherited stats are not resolved in this record.
Mass is from the recorded Core 1.7 source snapshot; other inherited stats remain unresolved.

use.body: Move chunks out of busy paths and into a chunk stockpile near the stonecutting work area. Raw stone obstructs movement and lowers indoor cleanliness and beauty. Choose a bill for the stone actually available: terrain and mining sources determine the supply, and a map does not guarantee every rock type.

summary: Gray veins cross the pale faces of these rough marble fragments.
